## المجموعة 78: شكل لاعب 1: البطاقة المرجعية

**الدفعة 2** (السبرنت 4)  
**المجلد:** `art/raw/players/look-1/`  
**المحادثة:** جديدة. لاعب عام بالحركات الأساسية. ابدأ بها: كل مجموعات هذه الشخصية ترفقها.

### 78.1 `ref.png`

البطاقة المرجعية: أمام، ثلاثة أرباع، جانب، خلف  
**بلا مرفق** (أول صورة)

```
A wide 3:2 landscape character reference card: exactly four full body views of the same one person side by side in one row, no more and no fewer, at exactly the same scale, standing on the same ground line, relaxed with arms slightly away from the body, nothing cut off. The character is a fictional male footballer in a plain pure white kit (white shirt, white shorts, white socks) and black boots, no logos or numbers (the game paints the team colours on the white), arab player: short black hair with a fade, neat full black beard, light brown skin, average height. From left to right: front view facing the camera, three-quarter view facing right, side view facing right, back view. There is no ball anywhere in the image, because the game draws the ball itself: where a pose mentions the ball, the body moves exactly as if the ball were there, but the ball is not drawn. Photorealistic 3D render in the style of a modern console football game, lit by night stadium floodlights from high above and slightly behind: cool bluish white light with a bright rim light on the head, shoulders and arms, and slightly darker lower legs. Correct, natural anatomy in every pose: knees and elbows bend the natural way, both legs and both arms complete, feet pointing where the body moves, five fingers on each hand. The background is one flat, solid chroma-key green (#00FF00) with nothing else on it, no floor and no shadows, so each figure is easy to cut out. The image has no text, no numbers and no logos.
```

## المجموعة 79: شكل لاعب 1: الجري بالاتجاهات

### 79.1 `run-side-01.png`

running: الإطارات 1 إلى 3 من 8  
**ارفق:** `art/raw/players/look-1/ref.png`

```
Use the attached reference card for this exact same person: the same face, hair, body and clothes, at the same scale. A wide 3:2 landscape image with 3 animation frames side by side in one row: frames 1 to 3 of an 8-frame running sequence. The image shows exactly 3 figures of this same one person, one per frame, from left to right in frame order: no more, no fewer, and no other people. The character is a fictional male footballer in a plain pure white kit (white shirt, white shorts, white socks) and black boots, no logos or numbers (the game paints the team colours on the white), arab player: short black hair with a fade, neat full black beard, light brown skin, average height. He is seen exactly from the side, his body and face turned to the right, so the camera sees his right side: his right leg and right arm are the near ones, closest to the camera, and his left leg and left arm are the far ones; whenever he moves, he moves to the right. These are consecutive animation frames for a 2D game sprite sheet, evenly spaced in time: each frame moves on one clear step of the motion from the one before, like a real animation cycle, and no two frames are the same. Every frame shows the whole figure from head to feet at exactly the same scale, standing on the same invisible ground line (the ground line is at the same height in every frame), with clear space between frames and nothing cut off. Each frame is a clearly different pose from the others in this image; never repeat a pose. Left frame (frame 1): Running fast (a real run, not a walk: long strides, body leaning slightly forward, elbows bent at a right angle and pumping): the near (right) foot just touching down in front of the body heel first, the far (left) leg stretched behind, the far (left) arm forward. Middle frame (frame 2): Running fast (a real run, not a walk: long strides, body leaning slightly forward, elbows bent at a right angle and pumping): the near (right) foot flat under the hips taking the weight, knee slightly bent, the far (left) leg swinging forward low. Right frame (frame 3): Running fast (a real run, not a walk: long strides, body leaning slightly forward, elbows bent at a right angle and pumping): only the toes of the near (right) foot still touch the ground, far behind the hips, the near (right) leg almost straight; the far (left) knee is lifted high in front at hip height with its foot off the ground. This pose must look clearly different from the first frame of the stride. There is no ball anywhere in the image, because the game draws the ball itself: where a pose mentions the ball, the body moves exactly as if the ball were there, but the ball is not drawn. Photorealistic 3D render in the style of a modern console football game, lit by night stadium floodlights from high above and slightly behind: cool bluish white light with a bright rim light on the head, shoulders and arms, and slightly darker lower legs. Correct, natural anatomy in every pose: knees and elbows bend the natural way, both legs and both arms complete, feet pointing where the body moves, five fingers on each hand. The background is one flat, solid chroma-key green (#00FF00) with nothing else on it, no floor and no shadows, so each figure is easy to cut out. The image has no text, no numbers and no logos.
```
